title: Daisy i no mangadza!
description: Bulasini ṱhukhu ho vha hu tshi dzula Daisy, khuhu ṱhukhu ye ya vha i tshi tama i tshi kona u fhufha.Dziṅwe khuhu dzoṱhe dzo vha dzi tshi sea nḓowenḓowe dzayo dza ḓuvha ḽiṅwe na ḽiṅwe.Fhedzi ḽiṅwe ḓuvha, ha bvelela zwiṅwe zwithu zwi no mangadza…
